result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect: in the 'Popular right now' section, the meta line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows overlapping text ('25–30 min' and '€0 delivery' rendered on top of each other), making both unreadable. Other elements (carousel clipping at the right edge, card cut off at the bottom) are expected behavior and not reported.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' title, the delivery-time text ('25–30 min') and the fee/category text ('€0 delivery · Ramen') overlap each other, producing garbled, unreadable text (e.g. '25–30Orderlivery').
issues.suggestion: Fix the meta row layout so the time, delivery fee, and cuisine tags are laid out inline or in separate non-overlapping containers (e.g. use a flex row with gaps or proper text concatenation) instead of absolutely positioned/overlapping elements.
